goal: Suppress Bora-facing pursuit and package work when a role's only current application path depends on the user-verified unusable massanf.taleo.net host, without blacklisting MassDOT or Massachusetts government employers when a different verified working official application route exists.
acceptance_conditions: massanf.taleo.net is explicitly recorded as a Bora-specific excluded application-route host based on direct user usability evidence

if a role's only current application route depends on massanf.taleo.net, current first-party actionability fails and this routes through the existing §135/§138.6 actionability consequence: WATCH/no serious application effort, unless an independent blocker already produces REJECT; this creates no new gate and does not amend §138.8, and package/tailoring/application work remains blocked under the existing actionability/package gates
MassDOT, MassCareers, and Massachusetts government employers are not globally blacklisted; a different verified working official ATS/application route may still be evaluated normally
the host exclusion is a Bora-specific pursuit/actionability rule, not a universal claim that Taleo or the employer is globally unavailable
the exclusion remains active until Bora explicitly revokes it after a successful direct usability re-test
fresh chats inherit the rule through .cursor/rules/role-selection.mdc

the MassDOT IT Data Analyst I 260005JH cold-start package is recorded as the motivating live failure and would now route to WATCH/no serious application effort under this doctrine, absent an independent blocker already producing REJECT
no resume, qualification, Candidate Truth, Match Truth, immigration, recency-window, start-horizon, schema, or runtime behavior is changed
stop_conditions: implementation requires any path outside allowed_paths
implementation would blacklist an employer rather than the specific unusable application-route host
implementation would make a universal claim about Taleo availability beyond Bora's verified usability evidence
implementation would alter Qualification Truth, Candidate Truth, Match Truth, immigration, resume/package doctrine, schemas, or runtime code
